note: The main army's time, played to the end (day limit 300, every game decided): seven switches on medium land maps, 24 games per config. A = armies instead of garrisons (townHeroes + secondArmy together: 0.61 against 0.48 in d926); T = a foreign town is worth what it yields on any day, and the main hero sees foreign towns 30 days off (townWorth); K = a shut-in army values the way out like a town (breakout); W = what an enemy hero's magic adds is taken from measurement (magicWorth: in a logged game a main hero with twice the enemy's army did not attack for 50 days because the model took the enemy hero for 2.9 times its army; the battle window showed attack 4, defence 8); F = no walking home for a trickle of troops (fetchByShare); H = no chasing of enemy heroes further off than today's march (noChase 1); P = the guard in the gap between two regions counts with the region behind it (passage with regionValue 8000: twice measured to bring a third to half a town more by day 42, lost again by day 84 while towns were not held). Design 2^(7-3), resolution IV: F = A*T*K, H = T*K*W, P = A*K*W; the plain standard and all seven together are among the 16. Why: in d921 the standard won 13 of 24 games played to the end, and the games it loses are those in which a main hero of 200,000 to 900,000 stays at home - walking between its own towns for troops and after enemy heroes it never catches (logged games on three templates); on a Balance M map a neutral town behind 59 familiars was left to the enemy. In six local games each, A with T, K, W, F, H scored 4 won, 0 lost, 2 open against 3, 2, 1 for A alone, the main hero's days going to foreign towns, exploring and fights instead. Replaces d928-doctrine (withdrawn after 15 minutes to add P). The results carry FairAI's own statistics (what the main hero spent its days on): arena/metrics.py shows them. Evaluate with arena/effects.py and arena/metrics.py: --factors '{"A": {"townHeroes": 1, "secondArmy": 1}, "T": {"townWorth": 1}, "K": {"breakout": 1}, "W": {"magicWorth": 1}, "F": {"fetchByShare": 1}, "H": {"noChase": 1}, "P": {"passage": 1, "regionValue": 8000}}'
